changed.what: The `ramp` grazing law consumes the per-region latent of N20a-24 (M3) and could not be built at M2 without a per-sample coin (forbidden by ADR-SENS-08): its kernel stage moved to N20a-24 (formula kept here, a `ramp` card is rejected until then). Defined the guarded comparison (the Guarded predicate class: bound E = c·u·S, exact fallback), resolved the contradiction between 'surfaces away from the limit' and the 0.30 m at-limit row (analytic plane, strictness at equality), noise keyed by world address (ADR-SENS-10), standard normal made explicit, quantization tie rule, units of σ coefficients, `detection_threshold` defined. Added dep BD-053 (guarded predicates), tests for equality fallback, ramp-card rejection, world-address keying, and the non-strict-comparison control.

Glass fixture was underdetermined (a 0.5-albedo wall's transmitted return outweighs the 0° direct return) and the 30° ranges were wrong (2 m and 4 m are perpendicular distances; along the ray 2.309 m and 4.619 m): specified albedo, thresholds and computed strengths. With the plan's polynomial R(85°) ≈ 0.65 for any r0, so a matte dry floor would show phantoms: added DESIGN roughness factor κ(w) = clamp(1 − w/(π/4), 0, 1) and a worked specular-floor fixture ((5.000, 0, −0.1375) m wet glossy; floor hit dry matte). Stated the strength convention, the wetness conditional, `acceptance_angle` as a glass-card field (refused if absent), tie rule; tests and mutant added.
Added dep N20a-21 (the second segment it charges must exist for its acceptance test); e2e now asserts the 0.75 m slab outcome (strength 0.0498, attenuated).

Pattern irradiance included the albedo (an irradiance excludes it; albedo and camera-side extinction cancel in the contrast ratio): corrected; defined E_a from zone level plus the region card's declared `emission`; volumes now an explicit check (`attenuated`, exp(−(τ_p + τ_c))) with dep N20a-22; noise keyed by world address; specular reject uses R·κ; grazing `ramp` routed to N20a-24; noise test given σ_disp and f·b.

Takes the `ramp` grazing kernel stage from N20a-20 (its first latent consumer): formula p = clamp((c0 − cos θ)/(c0 − c1), 0, 1), card admission, one dialect function shared with the pattern camera; dep N20a-20 added; tests for formula values, 4,096-episode frequency interval [0.228, 0.272], per-sample-coin mutant, card admission.

The KILL-EXPOSURE decision rule must be frozen before the pilot runs, but its decision bead N20a-27 starts only after the pilot: the pilot's frozen protocol now carries the rule (digest), and acceptance checks it.
Applies the rule frozen in the pilot's protocol (digest compared) instead of registering it itself after the pilot has run; a differing rule is refused.
New mask reason `bloom` and flag `truncated` must be added to the closed reason registry with the model (an unknown code is a load-time error).

M2 acceptance asked for a 'glass reason' that only exists at M3; now `unsupported-optical-class` and `beyond-range` at M2. Added dep BD-188 (the per-row and per-beam poses its overlay honours) and a rolling-shutter overlay test; named BD-191, N24a-40, N32b-10/-11 in Out.
Gave the exact binomial interval test its expected values (12/100: 90% [0.0707, 0.1872], 95% [0.0636, 0.2002]); other quoted intervals verified.

Corridor hand case was wrong: yawing the only beam to the end wall trades the null direction (W stays rank one, J_worst 0). Fixture now has a fixed side beam and a movable second sensor: W → (N/s²)·I, J_worst 0 → 10⁶ m⁻²; added the single-beam negative test.

Certified when t* ≤ t_info, but a packet arriving exactly at a decision instant is visible to that decision (boundary rule), so equality can leak θ: now strictly t* < t_info, stated in the certificate; acceptance and test `commitment_at_t_info_not_certified` added (3 s patch at 1 m/s, zero latency).

Author-declared pairs (one of the three sources that survive KILL-ALIAS) had no lane: added the declared lane first in order, with test. Refusal 445 must be wired into `train.start` (M2) at M3: dep N23a-14 and one lookup entry `alias::standing_witness`; the optimization refusal moved to BD-341 (opt.start is M4). On-time docking status pinned: `none exists` (abstraction scope, policy attached) replacing the M1 'none found' form.

Frozen protocol now carries the KILL-ALIAS decision rule (N20a-43 starts after the pilot, so it could not register it 'before the pilot's first run'). Ceiling measurement runs `sense.alias` with the Solid lanes: dep N20a-41 added.
Applies the rule frozen in the pilot's protocol (digest checked) instead of registering it itself; a differing rule is refused.

M1 bead whose acceptance required M2 every-tier passes: stages 12 (every tier), 14 and 15 now log `not due` and are the acceptance of BD-189 and N20a-10, which already run the script; it closes on referee/CPU rows. Stage 7's boundary assertion follows the ruled window convention; dep N20ap1-51 (ruling confirmed on the referee before the GATE-SENS-04 CPU record).

Moving-bar fixture lacked camera parameters; with the yaw-edge camera's 4 ms exposure the 9 ± 2 `mixed` answer is wrong (3.6): fixture now f = 600 px, 10 ms, four sub-instants (B = 6 px, 2·6·3/4 = 9); stage 10 owner N20a-26 named.

M2 bead with M3 acceptance ('passes all stages', gate records) and no M3 deps: closes on its M2 stages; M3 stages are fixed here and passed by their owners (N20a-21..24, N20a-31, BD-237, BD-238, which already run the script). Stage 9 corrected (2.000 m at 0°, 4.619 m along a 30° ray, fixture parameters); stage 10 asserts 0.75 m `attenuated`; self-test scoped to due stages.

M1 bead with M3 acceptance (empirical form, route profile, design-check warning): closes on stages 1-7; stages 8-13 fixed here, passed by BD-239 and N20a-34 (which already run it); self-test scoped to due stages.

M1 bead with M3 acceptance (stages 7-14): closes on stages 1-6; later stages passed by N20a-38/-39/-40/-41 and BD-240, which already run it; self-test scoped to due stages. Stages 2 and 5 state the status per milestone (M1 'none found: a separating policy exists'; M3 `none exists` with the policy).

Decision upstream of N12-42 (hence of the referee, event location, `window_contains`, the FT accumulator) yet its deciding experiment ran on that referee, and it re-owned N20a-06's function and lint. Now decides on an exact-rational model of the stated procedures (with a per-step device accumulator variant), specifies the function for N20a-06, records the model table; the referee experiment moved to new N20ap1-51, which re-applies the frozen rule on any mismatch. New model tests and e2e `window_rule_decide.sh`; dep STD-E2E.

E2E drove `frob run fork`, whose restore handling (N27a-05, N27a-08) depends on this bead: now drives both entry points on a real checkpoint through a crate example binary and BD-098's restore path (hand case A, refusal 441 at 3 vs 5, FromTruth/Keep, INV-SENS-02 over 10⁴ ticks); the fork-verb path is N27a-08's. Duplicate-ordering test wording corrected.

new_beads.why: Split from N20a-49: the boundary-impact experiment on the real referee in both WINDOW_RULE builds (committing step, stage order, receiving window, split-boundary sensor, mutants), compared cell by cell with N20a-49's model table; re-applies the frozen rule on mismatch. M1, deps BD-081, BD-082, N20a-06, N20a-16, N20a-49, STD-E2E; N20a-44 depends on it.

requests.what: Out list says the `ramp` grazing law with its region latent is N20a-20's; it is now N20a-24's (N20a-20 keeps the card field names and the deterministic stages).

Optical card schema has no `acceptance_angle` (needed by the glass rule, 'the card's acceptance angle') and gives no unit for `roughness`; N20a-21 reads roughness as the specular-lobe half-width in radians and requires `acceptance_angle` on `glass` cards.

Add N20a-49's model test `crates/frob-conformance/tests/window_rule_model.rs` to the single-definition lint's allow-list beside N12-42's oracle; the selector for `ClosesAt` must be usable by N20ap1-51's second build.
Consider dep N20ap1-51: the boundary row should freeze after the ruling is confirmed on the referee; on a reopening it is marked `pending N20a-49`.

From M3 the verb (N20a-41) reports the on-time docking case as `none exists` (scope: declared abstraction) with the same separating policy; tests asserting the literal 'none found' status should assert the policy and absence of a witness, or note the M3 status.
opt.start raises FROB-REF-445 through N20a-41's lookup entry `alias::standing_witness(interface, mission)`; N20a-41 no longer claims the optimization refusal at M3.
